# Vendored inference core

`vendor/seedvr2/` is a fixed source snapshot of `numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler` 2.5.24 at commit `4490bd1f482e026674543386bb2a4d176da245b9`.

Only its standalone CLI core is used. The application does not import the ComfyUI interface modules. See `vendor/seedvr2/LICENSE` after the source snapshot is populated.
